$comment: CHANWE brand tokens. This file is the source: tokens.css and tokens.scss are generated from it (npm run brand:tokens). Seeded on 2026-10-01 from chanwe-brand _extensions/chanwe-brand/brand.yml, aliases resolved. Body font moved from Inter to Satoshi on 2026-10-01: Satoshi everywhere (apps, Odoo, PDrive, documents, emails), Schibsted Grotesk for display, JetBrains Mono for labels. Inter left the body stack on 2026-10-08 (kit 0.25.0). Violet added on 2026-10-07 (kit 0.18.0) for the Reports tone: #7C3AED is the palette's code-number violet (5.7:1 on white, so it holds text), violet-soft its 12% wash on white, the pair read like status-info / status-info-bg. color.dark (0.42.0): the dark theme's values of the neutral palette entries; an entry not listed keeps its light value in the dark theme (the orange, the pure black and white, the chart colours). ink-light and ink-soft stay obsidian: they are surfaces, not text. Campo y Señal (kit 0.82.0, 2026-10-19): the motion family (four eases, five durations) and the hair and window radii, so the effects, the kit, the website, the sign-in and the desktop read one set. canvas and pane added on 2026-10-27 (kit 0.85.0, the Radar language): canvas is the ground the shell paints (#E9EEF4 light, #232A35 dark, the lighter obsidian) and pane the glass surfaces over it (white, #111319 dark); paper and surface-raised keep their values for documents and components. Radii pane 12 / row 8 / pill 999 for the shell, panes, rows and pills. CHANWE v2 (kit 0.93.0, 2026-10-29, brand/guide/guidelines/brand-v2.md): radii surface 16 (panes on a canvas page) and band 24 (obsidian bands, large panels), and the depth group: the shadows rest / lift / overlay, the top sheen and edge, the tint and the glass blur, light and dark, so chanwe.ar, emails and Odoo read the depth the kit draws. v2 unification (2026-10-29, docs/plans/2026-10-29-brand-v2-unification.md T1.1): space (the 4-based scale), control (heights), type (the compact scale), plot (charts: focus colour, slate ramp, categorical order, grid and axis, bar radius, line width) — generated for CSS, Sass, JS, Typst, R and Python so no surface types a value again.

state.$comment: 1.1.0: the orange's hover and pressed states as plain hex, for surfaces without color-mix (Odoo, Umami, Sass): the kit's --cw-primary-hover / --cw-primary-active, primary mixed 92% / 84% with ink in sRGB. Dark mixes with the dark theme's ink, as the kit does.

meta.$comment: 1.1.0: the browser chrome and manifest colours (<meta name="theme-color">, a manifest's theme_color and background_color): the canvas, light and dark, what server-page already sends.

depth.$comment: CHANWE v2 depth (brand-v2.md §4). Emitted as --cw-brand-<name>; dark replaces each under the dark theme.

light.shadow-lift: 0 1px 2px color-mix(in srgb, #111319 5%, transparent), 0 22px 40px -28px color-mix(in srgb, #111319 35%, transparent)
light.shadow-overlay: 0 24px 64px -24px color-mix(in srgb, #111319 40%, transparent), 0 0 0 1px color-mix(in srgb, #111319 6%, transparent)

control.$comment: Control heights, px (buttons, fields, pills, segmented switches). --cw-brand-control-<name>.

layout.$comment: 1.1.0: the shell's fixed sizes: the AppShell bar height (the desktop toolbar matches it).

type.$comment: The compact type scale (v2, 2026-10-29), px. Controls and tabs 12.5, buttons 13, body 14, pane titles 14; display steps for titles. --cw-brand-text-<name>.
type.label: 10px
type.caption: 11px
type.title: 14px

plot.$comment: Charts (v2, Q3 C1): orange is the one signal (the series that matters), the rest on the slate ramp; the categorical order only when a chart has no focus series. Grid: horizontal hairlines in slate at 25%; no axis lines; bars with rounded ends. --cw-brand-plot-<name>; lists as -1, -2…
